Goal `core-test-2-2` is **not** met. Its dossier check covers 13 members. Six have every proof on disk:
`assertNull`, `assertSame`, `assertThrows`, `sentSocket`, `double` and `partial`. Their benches are measured again in
`docs/perf/members.ndjson` after this session's change to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs`. Seven members own no
proofs at all yet (see the next group). The earlier handoff that called the goal met read only the members it had
touched. `bun nv proofs --verify --only <the argv's list>` is what says what is owed.

A chain of partials now shares one class descriptor per call site (`Doubles::behind`) and throws a `RecursionError`
at depth (`delegated`'s stack compare), pinned by
`tests/conformance/core/a-partial-of-a-partial-forwards-through-every-level-and-a-deep-chain-throws-a-recursion-error.nvst`.
